category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: Ordinary balanced scalp route: current exact-product intent is curl/wave hair care without a distinct oily, dry-scalp, sensitive or dandruff target; complete formula supports mild ordinary cleansing.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Low is favored by CAPB #3 plus mild anionic SCI #4 and late nonionic Coco-Glucoside #19, with Glyceryl Oleate #11 refatting. Moderate is the nearest alternative because surfactant actives are unknown; neither sulfate-free naming nor Aloe #2 alone determines mildness. Observed intensity: gentle.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: fine — Low weight plus bounded conditioning supports a broad fine-hair prior; not a guarantee of root lift. normal — Low cleansing and moderate conditioning support ordinary normal-diameter use; scalp loading still governs suitability. Conditional (not emitted): coarse — Limited high-deposition care leaves coarse/high-care needs conditional; formula-only evidence does not establish ideal fit across those needs.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Low is favored by CAPB #3 plus mild anionic SCI #4 and late nonionic Coco-Glucoside #19, with Glyceryl Oleate #11 refatting. Moderate is the nearest alternative because surfactant actives are unknown; neither sulfate-free naming nor Aloe #2 alone determines mildness.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate rinse-off care from Glyceryl Oleate #11 with cationic guar #17 and supporting emollient esters #16/#21. Above low because refatting plus substantive polymer form a coherent system; below high without rich fatty-alcohol/quat/silicone or 2-in-1 architecture. Amino acids do not prove repair.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole occurs in the complete supplied 33-ingredient sequence. Aloe/amino acids/humectants do not establish cosmetic anti-dandruff support.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: General is the closest supported v1.4 headline for a curl/wave-positioned shampoo: curl support has no v1.4 focus enum. Mild cleansing is compatible but is not substituted for the dominant curl intent; neither amino-acid claims nor curl naming establish repair.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: One secondary shine focus is supported by explicit exact-product shine positioning plus the compatible light cationic-guar/refatting surface-film route (#17/#11). The empty default was considered; a second volume focus is rejected because low weight alone is not an independent volumizing mechanism.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the current exact-product positioning addresses curls/waves, shine and bounce, not sensitive, dry or itchy scalp. Mild/refatting architecture is supportive context but does not create scalp intent; Parfum #9 remains an exposure counter-signal.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular remains the default: source directions provide no explicit daily/frequent schedule, reset role or recognized problem-led treatment. Gentle cleansing alone does not require a frequent-use role.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Low whole-formula weight potential: bounded refatting and one cationic guar route, without a rich nonvolatile oil/fatty-alcohol/silicone load. Moderate remains possible with unusually efficient guar deposition, but polymer presence and weak reset alone do not create a moderate floor.
